inv.desc_en:
� BAR TRANSFER IN ZARAGOZA FOR ONLY €12,000! �

� BAR RECONQUISTA – START WORKING RIGHT AWAY

Are you looking for your own hospitality business without making a large investment? This is your opportunity!

BAR RECONQUISTA is being transferred, an ideal opportunity for hospitality professionals, entrepreneurs, or couples who want to manage their own business and start a new professional chapter.

� TRANSFER PRICE: €12,000

� Ready to start working right away!

� RENT UNDER €800/MONTH, so you can control your fixed expenses and focus on growing your business.

Why let this opportunity slip away?

- Adjusted initial investment to enter the hospitality sector.
- Possibility to start activity from the very first moment, subject to verification of applicable conditions and licenses.
- Monthly rent under €800.
- Ideal for entrepreneurs looking for professional independence and who want to manage their own establishment.

� BAR RECONQUISTA – ZARAGOZA

If you have been thinking about having your own bar for a while, now you can take the step with a transfer investment of only €12,000.

� Request more information and arrange a visit.

Your next business may be closer than you imagine!

Transfer price: €12,000. Monthly rent under €800.
